$doc: SHARD-PLATFORM SF46 (G134): Driftwood's four midpoint entries walked edge -> shard and back with the hybrid row ON (sea at 0). Each inward leg starts 1 m inside the edge midpoint on the 8 x 15 m socket footprint (y 0), walks the sandbar to the pier / jetty's sea-end ramp (18 m in), along the deck and onto dry ground; each outward leg walks back to the edge (south / north / east over the sandbar beside the deck: the decks' island ends are steps down, never walk-ups, as before G134). Run: scripts/browser-lane.sh node scripts/physics-baseline.mjs --no-build --mode=walk --shard=driftwood-isle --route=progress/shard-platform/sf46/entries-route.json --device-save=debug.plugin.driftwood-isle.driftwoodHybrid=on --url=<served build> The last leg walks from the pier deck to the anchored boat and boards it up its starboard ladder (the ON world's replacement for the deck-to-boat step leg).

driftwood-isle.name: south in
driftwood-isle.notes: socket -> sandbar -> pier ramp -> deck -> landing -> dry sand

driftwood-isle.name: south out
driftwood-isle.notes: back over the sandbar beside the pier (west side, outside the moored boat): with the sea at 0 it is dry

driftwood-isle.name: north in
driftwood-isle.notes: jetty ends 60 m in over 0.5 m sand

driftwood-isle.name: north out
driftwood-isle.notes: beside the jetty on the sandbar (its island end is a 0.7 m step up, never a walk-up)

driftwood-isle.name: west in
driftwood-isle.notes: the jetty deck runs into the rising sand ~88 m in

driftwood-isle.name: east in
driftwood-isle.notes: jetty ends 72 m in, a 1.1 m step down to the cove's wet sand

driftwood-isle.name: east out
driftwood-isle.notes: beside the jetty on the sandbar (its island end is a 1.1 m step up)

driftwood-isle.name: pier to boat
driftwood-isle.notes: G134 pick A: off the deck between the pilings onto the sandbar, wade out to the boat at anchor off the sandbar edge (~0.9 m deep: wading, not swimming), walk up the boarding ladder hung over its starboard gunwale (steps 0.35 m apart: no jump) and drop onto its floor (0.32 m over the water)
